items.title: Billy Bauer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: And in Abe Lyman’s band we got in the USO.

ctx.x: Well Woody Herman was 1944. Did you have to join the service?

Yeah that was before I was with Abe Lyman, And in Abe Lyman’s band we got in the USO. And at that time, I don’t know if the war was coming down, but Glenn Miller, his band got shot up or something, and we were all — I was a Captain. I mean you know, like a captain rating it was. And I had all my shots, and everyday we’d play different embarkation camps around, all over Jersey, they’d fly us up to New England, and we’d play a show, but we never knew if we were going with them or not. They wouldn’t tell you. You…
They never told you where you were going?
